query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `businessUnits` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(150) NOT NULL,
  `code` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `type` enum('escritorio','filial','deposito','outro') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'escritorio',
  `address` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `responsibleName` varchar(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `responsiblePhone` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `businessUnits_code_unique` (`code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
